in_marathi.name: Lekha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lekha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Lekha means 'Line' or 'Script'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'lekh' which means 'to write'. This name is often given to girls whose parents aspire for them to become scholars, poets, or writers.
